function.arguments: {"analyst": "Observed strong mixes (mix-414, mix-226, mix-370) pair low water (145-162 kg/m3) with high binder, and weak mixes (mix-036) have high water with low cement, so low water-to-binder ratio is the main associated driver, though confounded with superplasticizer and binder type.", "candidate_ids": ["C01", "C02", "C03", "C05", "C07", "C10", "C08"], "evidence_ids": ["mix-414", "mix-226", "mix-036"], "hypothesis": "Menu mixes with water-to-binder ratio below 0.33 and water at or below about 170 kg/m3 will reach measured 28-day strength of at least 50 MPa, and the top model-ranked picks will outperform lower-ranked picks, with C10 and C07 as lower-uncertainty tests of this."}

input.analyst: Observed strong mixes (mix-414, mix-226, mix-370) pair low water (145-162 kg/m3) with high binder, and weak mixes (mix-036) have high water with low cement, so low water-to-binder ratio is the main associated driver, though confounded with superplasticizer and binder type.
